name: microservices-app
description: Mini E-Commerce Management System with API Gateway and microservices.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix services/inventory-service && npm install --prefix services/order-service && npm install --prefix services/payment-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix services/inventory-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/order-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/payment-service" "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix services/inventory-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/order-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/payment-service" "npm run dev --prefix gateway"
